summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the KWE Instant Quote Next.js app (Vite -> Next.js migration). Verified root redirect, 4-step quote flow, results page rendering, and Edit-search navigation. All requested feature checks PASS. No Admin Login button present. No uncaught JS errors during flow (only a benign HMR websocket warning from the preview proxy).
critical_code_review_comments: InstantQuote.jsx is ~1350 lines — consider splitting Step components (Step, StepFooter, LocationCard, ModeButton, CargoTypeButton, ServiceCard, Field/FieldInput, ContainerLine) into /components/instant-quote/*.jsx for maintainability.

getQuote() submits to backend best-effort but does not surface any success/failure UI state to the user (silent console.warn only). Acceptable per spec (NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL empty in preview) but consider a subtle indicator once wired.

InstantQuoteResults.jsx contains an unused `noRatesFound` indentation quirk (` const noRatesFound = ...` with a leading space) and unused imports (Anchor, Truck, Clock, Leaf, Star, Shield in results header path). Minor lint cleanup.

Edit-search button can be intercepted by the Sonner toast overlay when clicked immediately after submit (toast appears top-right and overlaps header CTA at some breakpoints). Not a functional bug — works after the toast auto-dismisses — but consider moving toast to bottom-right or reducing z-index on the toast container.
test_credentials: None required — public app, no auth.
seed_data_creation: None. Used sessionStorage payload injection for the isolated results-page navigation retest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL: https://255af966-4911-4270-89c1-838018f0f04b.preview.emergentagent.com. Full 4-step happy path verified with data-testids: iq-mode-air, iq-cargo-packages, 5 number inputs in Step 1 order [#Units, L, W, H, Weight], iq-unit-commodity-1, iq-step1-next, destination-port-select (Radix Select — click trigger then wait 400ms then click a [role='option']), iq-ready-date (default = today+7), iq-required-delivery-date (must be > readyDate), iq-step2-next, iq-step3-next, contact-fullname/company/email/phone, iq-get-quote. Results page loads offer cards from client-side pricing engine (e.g. HKG destination -> 6 KWE air offers). iq-edit-search returns to /instant-quote. NOTE: If clicking iq-edit-search immediately after navigation, first scroll to top and/or dismiss the Sonner success toast — the toast overlay can intercept clicks in the header region.
